title: lupinus sericeus subsp. sabinii
intro: Lupinus sericeus subsp. sabinii, commonly known as Sabin's lupine or silky lupine, is a plant species that belongs to the lupine family and is native to the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus sericeus subsp. sabinii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
